description: Witness address vectors: bech32m (BIP-350), one witness version character, a 32-byte program.
networks maps each network name to its address prefix.

valid: on a network with this prefix, the program at this witness version encodes to this address, and the address decodes to the program. program is hex in the order the bytes sit in the output script; the script is the version opcode (OP_1 = 0x51, OP_6 = 0x56), the push 0x20, the program.
The encoder writes lower case. A decoder also accepts a valid address written entirely in upper case.

invalid: a decoder for this witness version on a network with this prefix refuses the address. reason names the first check the string fails, in this order: empty, whitespace, mixed_case, length_over_90, separator_missing, prefix_empty, checksum_short, character, checksum_bech32, checksum, prefix, version, padding, program_length.
